description: Register a gateway-mode affiliation — bring an existing account/credentials with the provider instead of having Rinne provision a new one.

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID to scope this call to (uses /v1/merchants/{merchant_id}/...). Omit to act at the organization/self level with an org-scoped key.

provider_credentials.description: Existing credentials with the provider (gateway mode). Shape is provider-specific; passed through as-is.

name: register_affiliation
